how: The China Science and Technology Museum is a national-level science museum with exhibition halls, labs and special-effect theatres beside the Olympic Green.
The Museum of the War of Chinese People's Resistance Against Japanese Aggression at Wanping Fortress covers the Second Sino-Japanese War in four halls.
venue: Museum of the War of Chinese People's Resistance Against Japanese Aggression

how: The Beijing Go Club teaches and plays go (weiqi) weekly on Wednesdays, open to all levels and especially beginners.
Board game cafes sell hourly or per-person tables with libraries of games, such as Big Devil King overlooking the CBD.
venue: Big Devil King Board Game Cafe

how: Cosmic Bowling is a 20-lane ten-pin alley inside the Lido Hotel, open evenings daily.
Lush in Wudaokou runs a quiz night every Wednesday at 8pm; Paddy O'Shea's also lists a free Wednesday quiz night (listing may be dated).
The Olympic Sports Centre Paintball Strike Range near subway line 4 offers paintball and laser tag.
venue: Olympic Sports Centre Paintball Strike Range

how: The Beijing Qiwan Miniature Wargame Club is listed as a miniature wargaming club; whether it plays Warhammer specifically is not stated.
Da Yin Jia Arcade is a small arcade covering the main video game genres; other arcades are listed in the Beijinger gaming-club directory.
The Beijing International Fashion Sports Park (formerly Woodward Beijing) is the city's largest skate park and runs classes from BMX freestyle to dry-land snowboarding.
venue: Beijing International Fashion Sports Park (Woodward Beijing)

activity: Hands-on cooking classes (pasta and other cuisines)
how: Black Sesame Kitchen runs scheduled and private hands-on cooking classes in a hutong courtyard, with a minimum of four guests for private bookings.

activity: Artisan bread and pastry baking courses
how: Haollee Professional Baking Classes teaches professional baking, patisserie and cake design in Chaoyang.
The Beijing Linux User Group (BLUG) is a community tech group listed in the Beijinger directory.
The Beijing Language Exchange Meetup Group holds weekly Talkspace sessions (Friday evening and Sunday English Corner).
Toastmasters-format meetings run weekly on Sundays via PET International Friends and Beijing Chinese Language Group on Meetup.
The PET Reading Club meets every Sunday afternoon to share a book, organised through Meetup.
Meetup hosts frequent social events in Beijing such as game nights, frisbee, salsa and world-traveller parties (PET International Friends, Beijing Chinese Language Group).
PET International Friends advertises a recurring cocktail tasting-and-making workshop through Meetup.
Casa Flamenco in the CBD teaches flamenco dance and guitar for all levels, taught by teachers trained in Spain and the USA.
Casa Flamenco (CBD) offers Spanish language classes, and Berlitz lists Spanish among its courses.
Berlitz Language Training Center lists German among its courses, with private tutorials available.
Berlitz Language Training Center lists Japanese among its courses, with private tutorials available.
Shou Designers' Jewelry Academy is a jewelry-making school with classes from beginner to professional level.
A small hutong workshop (Shuiguiqi Traditional Cultural Workshop) offers drop-in sessions in embroidery, tie-dye and clay figurines for about RMB 30 per session.
Beijing Wine Club holds monthly tasting events (blind tastings, wine quizzes) with some wine education; no WSET course was confirmed.
Li-Pi Records in the 798 Art District is a large, well-stocked vinyl record store operating since 2008.
The urban area has no natural snow terrain; the nearest snowboard park is at Nanshan Ski Village in Miyun, about 108 km from the centre (roughly 1.5-2 hours by shuttle bus).
Jing-A Brewery runs craft taprooms across Beijing (CBD, 798, Wangjing and others); no public brewing classes were confirmed.
The Beijing Film Actors and Producers Group meets weekly to perform and film scenes, with a director teaching film acting and production.
venue: Beijing Film Actors and Producers Group

how: The China Culture Center offers guided English-language tours, day trips and weekend excursions around Beijing.
Our Beijing runs mahjong workshops for visitors, and mahjong game rooms are common in the city.
Mr. X is a well-known Beijing escape-room operator with English-language rooms such as The House of Suicide and Alcatraz, bookable via Dianping.
The Hutong cooking school teaches hands-on dumpling and xiaolongbao classes at its Beixinqiao courtyard.
UCCA Center for Contemporary Art in the 798 Art Zone is open daily 10:00-19:00 with major contemporary exhibitions (Carsten Holler: Two through January 2027).
The Capital Museum in Xicheng is open 9:00-20:00 (closed Tuesdays) with permanent history and art exhibitions plus visiting shows.
The Camera Stylo chess club (founded by David Burgess) meets for casual games and tournaments at a Gulou cafe-bar, open to all ages and levels (2021 article; venue may have changed).

Beijing hosts 480+ bird species with sites such as Olympic Forest Park, Yuyuantan Park and Beijing Botanical Garden, and the Beijing Birdwatching Society (400+ members) is the local club (2017 article).
Steamed Bun Comics sells 2,000-3,000 Marvel, DC and Dark Horse comics from inside The Factory bar and music venue in Gulou.
The Weibo IN Interdimensional Gravitational Zone, an anime/comic/game complex in the former Olympic Volleyball Stadium at Chaoyang Park, draws visitors in cosplay and hosts fandom events.
The Weibo IN Interdimensional Gravitational Zone at Chaoyang Park includes an esports venue and a VR game among its attractions.
The Weibo IN Interdimensional Gravitational Zone at Chaoyang Park includes a VR game attraction.
Yinpobian, a small Gulou cafe, ran a Monday-night barista class covering espresso machine use and latte art for about RMB 99 (2015 listing).
Charles' Whisky Bar in Sanyuanqiao offers whisky by the glass with an aroma-sampling corner; Atlas Whisky Bar in Sanlitun stocks about 240 whiskies (2016-2018 articles).
On Pointe Dance Studio teaches ballet, jazz and tap, mainly for expat children.
Khan Kon, an annual bilingual gaming convention in Beijing, features Dungeons & Dragons, Pathfinder and other tabletop RPG sessions (2014 listing).
Khan Kon, an annual Beijing gaming convention, hosts a Magic: The Gathering tournament (2014 listing).
Lush in Wudaokou hosts a Sunday-night open mic described as the most eclectic in town.
Winter ice swimming takes place at Houhai lake, where hundreds of swimmers dived in on National Ice Swimming Day (2009 report).
Beijing is inland, about 150 km from the Bohai Sea coast near Tianjin, so no whale or dolphin watching exists in the metro area.
Beijing is inland with no beaches; the nearest coast is the Bohai Sea near Tianjin, about 150 km away.
The China Honey Bee Museum at the Botanical Garden in Fragrant Hills offers honey sampling and beekeeping exhibits, but no hands-on beekeeping course was found.
